mods.description: This is an example description! Tell everyone what your mod is about!

releases.notes:
First development version.

Feature framework (Feature interface, registry, per-feature JSON configs, config screens),
Appearance (game icon, window title), Combat Tweaks (pre-1.9 combat), first Animatium.

Note: this jar was built later from the tagged code with the version set to 0.1.0
(the tagged gradle.properties still said 1.0.0). Use v0.2.0 or newer for play.
Requires Minecraft 1.21.1, Fabric API, Java 21.

mods.name: FirstOne Framework
mods.description: Brings back the feel of Minecraft 1.7.10 on Fabric 1.21.1: legacy animations, 1.7.10 knockback, hitboxes, drops and boats, pre-1.9 combat, the 1.7.10 HUD, your own cosmetic effects and game window tweaks. Every feature is a separate module with its own in-game settings.

releases.notes:
New features: Legacy HUD (1.7.10 effect list), Cosmetics (death, item break and music disc
sounds from your own files), Legacy Vehicles (1.7.10 boats: handling, riding, model, hands,
mobs turn in boats).
Animatium: 1.7.10 item positions and poses, sword blocking pose, hurt tilt, ground items,
fall particles, re-equip and item use fixes.
Legacy Mechanics: 1.7.10 drops and experience, regeneration, sword blocking, boats,
drop items on close.
Config GUI with category menus; in-game dev tests for every feature (not in the jar).
Requires Fabric Loader >= 0.16.0, Fabric API, Minecraft 1.21.1, Java 21.

readmeSummary: A framework for developing Minecraft Fabric 1.21.1 mods with a clear structure, where new features can be added easily without modifying existing ones
